clients._differentiator: Fully managed, end to end — most 'outreach tools' hand you a platform and wish you luck. We don't. We source the contacts, write the sequences, handle every reply, and only surface a conversation when someone is actually interested. The other difference: our system runs on AI that personalizes every email to the specific company we're reaching out to — not a template blast. It reads their website and writes an opening line specific to their business before anything sends.
clients._business_description: We help professional services firms build a consistent pipeline of new client meetings — without their team doing any prospecting. We handle everything: finding the right contacts, writing personalized outreach in your voice, managing replies, and routing interested prospects straight to your calendar. You just show up to the meetings
